business_scope.primary_industry_name: Real-Time Video Matching and Cross-Border Social Telephony

meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: Republic of the Marshall Islands (Aolepān Aorōkin M̧ajeļ)
meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) — Business Corporations Act corporate registry, Majuro
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: common-law statutory corporate regime (US/Delaware-derived), constitutional rule of law, and customary law (Bwij) elements; commercial legislation is enacted and interpreted in English; the RMI High Court exercises general jurisdiction over corporate matters.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States of America (1986, as amended 2003) — economic provisions and tax-budget nexus; no standalone investor-state arbitration clause

Agreement between the Government of the United States of America and the Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands to Improve International Tax Compliance and Implement the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (Model 1 FATCA IGA, signed 2014)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER Plus, signed 2017, in force December 2020)
No comprehensive double taxation agreement is in force for the RMI; non-resident Business Corporations are exempt from RMI income tax under the RMI Income Tax Act

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012 (as amended) and RMI Financial Intelligence Unit Regulations/Guidance; Banking Act 1990 (as amended); Business Corporations Act, Title 24 RMI Revised Code (as amended), imposing beneficial-ownership record-keeping, registered-agent customer due diligence, and government-access UBO reporting; UN Security Council targeted financial sanctions implemented under RMI law; FATF standards applied through the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) membership.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of passport of each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of the individual's country of nationality; copy certified by a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the origin state is an Apostille Convention contracting party; otherwise full consular legalization. The RMI is not an Apostille contracting party and does not issue apostilles.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, issued within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or issuing bank in the individual's country of residence; certification by a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille or consular legalization, as applicable to the origin state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance / criminal records certificate for each director and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police or criminal-records bureau of each country of residence over the preceding 5 years
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization required for foreign public documents; the Registered Agent may accept an original certified extract in low-risk cases per its AML manual

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney and signatory appointment authorizing the RMI Registered Agent to incorporate and file UBO information
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization; apostille or consular legalization where the Registered Agent's CDD policy requires authentication of a general power of attorney

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified bank reference letter confirming account relationship of the UBO / funding source
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Correspondent or issuing bank of the UBO and the proposed payment-rail settlement accounts (Apple IAP, Paymentwall)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original on bank letterhead with authorized-signature verification; consular authentication only if the receiving bank counterparty demands it

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Registry extract / certificate of good standing where any UBO or director is a legal entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or corporate agent of the entity's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization of the foreign corporate extract

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every UBO, director, and authorized signatory against: (a) the RMI FIU domestic designation list; (b) the UN Security Council consolidated and other UN sanctions lists; (c) OFAC SDN and sectoral sanctions lists, given USD-denominated payment rails (Apple IAP, Paymentwall); (d) the EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists, given European consumer exposure; and (e) PEP databases with enhanced due diligence on source of funds and source of wealth where PEP status is identified. Positive matches are escalated to the Registered Agent's MLRO, a suspicious transaction report is considered under the AML/CFT Act 2012, and incorporation proceeds only after a clean screen or a formally documented risk decision.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Corporate Registry — Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro; there is no unrestricted public web portal, and name searches and reservations are lodged exclusively through licensed RMI Registered Agents.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be composed in Latin-script English characters and must include a statutory corporate designator (Corporation, Incorporated, Company, Limited, or an approved abbreviation). Foreign-script names require an anglicized transliteration, and the transliterated form controls the registered name. Hyphens, ampersands, numerals, and spaces are permitted; the name must not misrepresent the entity's nationality, purpose, or regulated status.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On name rejection, the applicant, through its Licensed Registered Agent, may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 10 business days, stating grounds of distinguishability and producing evidence of prior use, consent, or ministerial approval where a sensitive token is involved. The Registrar must issue a written decision within 10 business days; judicial review may be sought in the RMI High Court if the administrative appeal is denied. A name reservation may be renewed for successive 30-day periods on re-filing with the statutory fee; after expiry the name returns to the public pool.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is accepted for commercial correspondence and remote operations of this video-match social application, and no RMI premises, employees, or local assets are required for non-resident Business Corporation status. However, the statutory registered office must be a physical address in the Republic of the Marshall Islands maintained by the Licensed Registered Agent (typically Majuro) for service of process and official communications; the Registered Agent's address is the registered office and may not be replaced by an overseas virtual-office address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: approximately 3% annual baseline probability for a non-resident entity with no RMI premises, no local license requirement, and no RMI-source revenue. The probability rises to 30–50% if a suspicious transaction report, sanctions hit, or PEP/UBO escalation occurs, because the RMI FIU and Registrar retain unannounced inspection powers under the AML/CFT Act 2012.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate name search and 30-day name reservation fee (two candidate names)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per the Registrar's corporate fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government filing fee for certificate of incorporation — non-resident Business Corporation, authorized capital up to US$50,000
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Title 24 RMI Revised Code fee schedule, capital-band scaled

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial-ownership (UBO) register establishment and government-access custody filing under the AML/CFT Act 2012
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations / RMI Financial Intelligence Unit (lodged through the Licensed Registered Agent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: AML statutory compliance charge; prevailing market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed Registered Agent and statutory registered office service (first 12 months)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per the Licensed Registered Agent's published fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Enhanced due diligence dossier — UBO identification, source-of-funds capture, PEP/OFAC/UN sanctions screening, and risk rating for a Medium_Risk_Enhanced entity
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML/CFT compliance officer of the Corporate Service Provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for enhanced due diligence on a non-resident video-match/social-telephony entity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Police clearance / criminal records certificates for directors and UBOs (per jurisdiction of residence)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: National police or criminal-records authorities and local verification agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Pass-through statutory fees plus market benchmark verification charge

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and authentication bundle — apostille or consular legalization of the UBO/director document set
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public(s) and consular posts of the origin states and destination country as applicable
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff schedule and per-document consular fee; market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Contingency reserve — administrative appeal drafting and filing in the event of name rejection
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (appeal filing fee) and external counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for administrative-law drafting and filing

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act, Title 26 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code, Chapter 1, Sections 51-58 (incorporation), Section 64 (defective filing cure), Sections 72-75 (registered agent and registered office), and Sections 95-105 (directors and officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Division of International Business, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BC-1) together with the Registered Agent Consent and Appointment Form, filed electronically or in paper form with the Registrar of Corporations.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow deposit requirement; one or more shares of common stock may be issued for such consideration as the board determines, and shares may be issued without par value.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: BE IT RESOLVED, at the first board meeting of the Corporation: 1. That the Corporation accepts the subscription of one hundred (100) fully paid and non-assessable shares of common stock, par value US$1.00 each, issued to the sole incorporator, such shares being the entire issued capital and no further payment being due. 2. That the registered office of the Corporation is fixed at the office of its licensed registered agent in Majuro, Marshall Islands, and the registered agent is appointed to accept service of process. 3. That [Name] is appointed President and [Name] is appointed Secretary-Treasurer, with authority to open bank and payment-rail accounts (including Apple IAP and Paymentwall), sign contracts, and effect all Business Corporations Act filings. 4. That the officers are authorized to obtain exempt-entity certificates and maintain corporate records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Division of International Business, Majuro (online verification portal maintained by the Registry).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written or electronic name-clearing request quoting the proposed corporate name, including the mandatory designator 'Corporation', 'Company', 'Incorporated', or 'Limited'. The Registrar checks the name against the corporate index and, if available, reserves it for a period not exceeding 120 days pending filing of the Articles of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Corporate name reservation request form
Identity document of the incorporator or authorized filer
Name screening/similarity search confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused for similarity or prohibited wording, the applicant may file an amended name request with distinguishing elements or seek a written variance ruling from the Registrar within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator or licensed Marshall Islands registered agent acting as preparer; no government approval required at this stage.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation setting forth the corporate name, registered agent name and Majuro street address, authorized share structure, permitted business purpose covering data processing and real-time video matching services, and any lawful limitation of liability provisions. The incorporator executes the Articles before a notary public; the registered agent executes the separate Consent and Appointment of Registered Agent form.
required_dossiers: Articles of Incorporation executed by the incorporator
Consent and Appointment of Registered Agent (signed by licensed agent)
Registered agent address confirmation in Majuro
Notarized identity documents of the incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Defects in execution or missing notarization are cured by re-execution and re-notarization; no penalty is imposed if the corrected instrument is resubmitted before the statutory filing is rejected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing of Articles of Incorporation and Payment of Government Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Division of International Business, Ministry of Finance, Majuro.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Articles of Incorporation together with the registered agent consent and the US$275 state filing fee through the Registry's authorized e-filing channel or by physical lodgment at the Majuro Registry window. The filing must include a certification that the corporation is to be formed as a non-resident domestic entity for tax-exempt status. The Registrar issues a file-stamped acknowledgement upon acceptance.
required_dossiers: File-stamped Articles of Incorporation (Form BC-1)
Registered agent consent and appointment form
Government filing fee remittance proof (US$275)
Cover letter identifying non-resident domestic status
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a rejection or query letter, the incorporator may amend and resubmit the Articles within 30 days under Section 64 of the Act; persistent refusal may be appealed to the High Court of the Marshall Islands for judicial review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Organizational Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (certificate issuance); corporation's board of directors (organizational acts).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon acceptance of the Articles, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The incorporator or initial directors then hold the organizational meeting, adopt the bylaws, approve the First Board Resolution covering share subscription, registered office confirmation, and officer appointments, and issue the subscribed share certificates to the shareholder.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar
Adopted corporate bylaws
First Board Resolution (signed minutes)
Share certificate and share ledger
Acceptance letters of appointed directors/officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Failure to hold the organizational meeting within the initial period is cured by unanimous written consent in lieu of meeting; any irregularity in share issuance is ratified by subsequent board resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Registration of Exempt Status and Certificate of Good Standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations and Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the annual designation of the corporation as a non-resident domestic entity to maintain tax-exempt treatment, open the annual franchise tax account, and obtain a Certificate of Good Standing confirming the corporation's valid existence for bank account opening and payment-rail onboarding (Apple IAP and Paymentwall).
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Non-resident domestic corporation designation statement
Registered agent confirmation of continued appointment
Completed annual franchise tax registration form
Certificate of Good Standing request form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the exempt designation is queried due to incomplete records, the corporation may submit a curative affidavit and amended declaration; reinstatement of good standing is available upon payment of the applicable annual fee and filing of all delinquent declarations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - the non-resident real-time video matching and social telephony service qualifies as an information-service activity outside the scope of Marshall Islands industrial licensing; residual oversight authority is held by the Environmental Protection Authority for leased-office environmental compliance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None - no manufacturing, industrial, or statutory operating license is imposed on a non-resident video-matching and social-telephony application under the Business Corporations Act or the Foreign Investment Business Act, given the absence of a physical commercial establishment in the Marshall Islands.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA), Republic of the Marshall Islands.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category Exempt - office-only administrative use with no industrial process, no effluent discharge, and no land disturbance; neither a full Environmental Impact Assessment nor an Environmental Survey is required. A simple EPA notification letter may be issued upon request for the registered-agent office premises.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC emission thresholds apply. If a leased physical office is maintained, compliance is limited to: (i) discharge of domestic sanitary wastewater to municipal sewer in accordance with EPA Water Quality Regulations; (ii) disposal of IT and electronic waste through EPA-approved recyclers under the Solid Waste Management Regulations; and (iii) de minimis office emissions within EPA ambient air quality ceilings.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Inspection Certificate from the Majuro Fire and Rescue Service covering the registered office or any leased premises; structural load inspection certification under the Marshall Islands Building Code where office occupancy is established; and Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) workplace clearance addressing electrical installation safety, emergency evacuation signage, and compliant workstation configuration for all personnel.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance, Revenue and Tax Administration, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands; no dedicated taxpayer online portal is operational, and tax and customs interactions are conducted through the Ministry of Finance and its Customs Division.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation (MH_BC) under the Marshall Islands Business Corporation Act is statutorily tax-exempt and is not required to obtain a TIN solely for incorporation. If a TIN is needed for customs registration, banking, or voluntary compliance, the foreign entity must file the RMI Taxpayer Registration Form with the Revenue and Tax Administration, accompanied by: (i) certified Articles of Incorporation and Good Standing Certificate issued by the RMI Registrar of Business Corporations; (ii) the registered agent's name and Majuro office address; (iii) identification of directors and ultimate beneficial owners; and (iv) a board resolution confirming the domestic registered agent. The TIN is issued within approximately five working days. No VAT identification number exists because the Marshall Islands has no VAT/GST regime.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election is available under Marshall Islands law. A non-resident Business Corporation is automatically classified as a domestic corporation under the BCCA but is wholly tax-exempt while it remains non-resident. The only relevant statutory election is the decision to cease non-resident status by applying for a domestic business license, which would trigger the RMI gross revenue tax and business license fees; there is no pass-through or entity-level income tax election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST; limited Gross Revenue Tax on resident licensed businesses and customs duties on physical imports/exports
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No VAT/GST threshold. The RMI Gross Revenue Tax (Title 54, RMI Code) applies to every resident business license holder from the first US dollar of gross revenue at a rate generally quoted as 3%, unless specifically exempt; a non-resident Business Corporation is outside the charge to gross revenue tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing or real-time fiscal clearance mandate exists. The Marshall Islands does not operate a CTC/e-invoice API, digital stamping platform, or any real-time transaction clearance requirement.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. The Marshall Islands does not impose VAT/GST, so there is no export zero-rating mechanism or VAT refund to claim. Physical exports are subject to customs procedural requirements only, and offshore services supplied by a non-resident Business Corporation are outside the territorial scope of RMI gross revenue tax.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration / Exit Certificate (required only for physical exports)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank issued receipt (maintained for due diligence, not for VAT substantiation)
Commercial Invoice and Packing List for physical export customs clearance
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: There is no export VAT zero-rating regime and therefore no export refund to claw back. For physical export transactions, false or inaccurate customs declarations are penalized under the RMI Customs Code with fines, forfeiture of goods, and potential criminal prosecution. The non-resident Business Corporation remains exempt from income and gross revenue taxes, so no income-tax audit exposure arises from offshore service revenue.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands - Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance (no central bank exists; the U.S. Federal Reserve acts as the monetary authority for the U.S. dollar, which is the sole legal tender)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Fully convertible USD environment. There are no exchange controls, no capital/current account distinction, and no requirement for central bank approval. Dividends, loan repayments, and capital proceeds may be freely remitted. Practical limitations arise only from bank-level compliance: beneficial ownership, source of funds, and sanctions screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. Marshall Islands law imposes no statutory conversion, surrender, or rationing of export receipts. Export proceeds can be retained, held, or disbursed in U.S. dollars indefinitely, subject only to AML/CTF transaction reporting and record-keeping requirements.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium as a collection conduit; Low as a treasury substitute. RMI has no domestic EMI licensing regime and no digital currency framework, so offshore EMIs are unregulated locally. An offshore EMI must be licensed in a FATF-compliant jurisdiction and contracted directly to the RMI BC; however, local commercial banks will likely deem such accounts high-risk and may require unwind to a local bank. Use Paymentwall/Apple IAP only for micro-collection, with daily or weekly sweeps into a licensed RMI bank account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical onboarding is the default. Directors, signatories, and 10%+ UBOs must personally appear before a bank compliance officer or an authorized notary/consular officer with original, valid IDs. A remote opening is not generally available for newly formed non-resident BCs; if a bank permits it, it will require a live video interview, independent verification by the registered agent, and enhanced due diligence approval.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated non-resident RMI BC with no trading history, nominee registered agent, and non-resident shareholders.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Articles of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, registered agent appointment certificate, board resolutions, share register and UBO declarations, certificate of incumbency, detailed business plan for the video matching app, group structure chart, and a shareholder source-of-funds statement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Digital cross-border social telephony business with high transaction velocity and perceived fraud/chargeback exposure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: AML/CTF policy, user identity verification procedures (liveness/age checks), transaction flow diagram, Apple IAP and Paymentwall agreements, projected payouts and volumes, chargeback and refund policy, data protection and privacy policy, and evidence of compliance with app store terms.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection originating from a third-country bank, crypto liquidation, or complex personal wealth structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 12-month bank statements of the funding account, share subscription agreement, board approval for capital injection, declaration of source of wealth, crypto exchange statements with chain analytics if applicable, tax returns from home jurisdiction, and an independent legal opinion where useful.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, or adverse media hits, including any user-routing to OFAC/UN/EU sanctioned jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions and PEP screening reports, negative news analysis, geo-blocking and IP-country controls, contractual prohibitions on sanctioned counterparties, senior management attestation, and a third-party compliance audit report.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Remit only in USD via SWIFT MT103/MT202 to the RMI bank account. Use beneficiary account number exactly as in the bank mandate and include in Field 70: 'EQUITY SUBSCRIPTION / CAPITAL INJECTION'; if the receiving bank requires an ISO 20022 purpose code, use 'EQUI' (equity) or an equivalent accepted code. Provide beforehand to the bank: board resolution authorizing the capital increase, share subscription agreement, certificate of good standing, and source-of-funds declaration. No RMI government approval or FX form is required.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: USD settlement uses SWIFT MT103 for ordinary vendor payments and batch disbursements, cleared through the bank's U.S. correspondent over CHIPS/Fedwire. For larger or documentary trade, use irrevocable commercial letters of credit advised through a confirming bank. For app-related payouts (moderators, content providers), send batch MT103 with clear remittance references and supporting service/invoice documentation to prevent AML return. Apple IAP and Paymentwall proceeds are swept to the RMI operating account on their settlement cycles.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla USD/FX forwards and cash-settled nondeliverable forwards (NDFs) executed offshore with an OECD-licensed banking counterparty.
Cross-currency swaps (USD versus settlement currencies) documented under ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with a CSA collateral arrangement.
European-style FX options for budgeted currency conversions, used exclusively for risk-hedging rather than speculation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Report and Franchise Tax Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Business Registry, Majuro
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 April each year; initial filing is due by 30 April of the calendar year following incorporation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of US$100; unpaid annual franchise tax outstanding 90 days after notice triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution; reinstatement requires payment of all arrears and penalties.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit threshold applies under the Business Corporations Act to non-resident tax-exempt Business Corporations; independent audit is required only when shareholder(s) holding not less than 10% of voting rights demand it, when the board resolves an audit for financing purposes, or when a financial regulator or payment acquirer requests audited financial statements as a contractual condition.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Marshall Islands law prescribes no local statutory financial reporting framework for exempt non-resident corporations; records may be maintained under IFRS or US GAAP as selected by management and must be capable of producing accurate financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Marshall Islands Registered Agent must obtain and hold beneficial ownership particulars before accepting engagement and must reconfirm those particulars annually on each company anniversary; any share transfer or entitlement change must be notified to the Registered Agent within 14 days, after which the beneficial ownership register is updated and re-confirmed. Failure to provide annual UBO confirmation is an AML compliance breach, may cause the Registered Agent to resign, and may be reported to the Financial Intelligence Unit.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Beneficial Ownership Register (maintained by the Registered Agent)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; voluntary or group-driven certified audit typically ranges from US$4,000 to US$10,000 per annum

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax is imposed on non-resident Business Corporations in the Marshall Islands. The zero-tax regime is the statutory default for foreign-owned BCs; no tax holidays or preferential deductions exist because none are necessary. All foreign-source income is exempt, and no domestic-source income tax applies to a non-resident BC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: None – Marshall Islands does not require a corporate income tax return. For statutory compliance, the only filing is the Annual Business Report (ABR) submitted to the Registrar of Corporations via the online portal or through a registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Business Report must be filed by the anniversary date of the issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation, not the fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of each beneficial shareholder and ownership percentage.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Filed confidentially with the Registrar; non-resident shareholders may be listed without local disclosure.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalties include a base fee plus accrued monthly surcharge, typically totaling USD 100 to USD 500, depending on the delay. Persistent non-filing for two consecutive years triggers administrative dissolution; reinstatement requires payment of back fees and penalties. No tax-specific surcharges apply because no income tax return exists.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Marshall Islands has no comprehensive double tax agreement (DTA) network. Dividend distributions to non-resident shareholders are not subject to any Marshall Islands withholding tax, and no treaty relief procedure or Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) is required for local purposes. A Certificate of Residence may be obtained from the Registrar for foreign filing convenience but it does not confer treaty benefits and is merely a factual attestation of incorporation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding is 0% on royalties and interest paid to non-residents. Because the Marshall Islands has no DTA network, the treaty rate is identical at 0%; no gross-up is required under local law.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: USD 0 – The Marshall Islands imposes no local transfer pricing documentation requirement. No Local File or Master File threshold is triggered in-country. However, if the entity is part of a multinational group with controlling tax authorities (e.g., IRS, HMRC), those foreign TP documentation rules will apply based on the group's consolidated revenue and related-party transaction thresholds.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) 2020 apply to entities conducting 'relevant activities' as defined by the OECD. A non-resident BC used for a video-match social app, deriving income from customer subscriptions and advertising, will only fall within ESR if it carries on a relevant activity such as intellectual property holding, distribution and service centres, shipping, or financing/leasing. Merely outsourcing all platform operations to third-party service providers does not automatically trigger ESR, but the entity must avoid booking IP royalties or loans in the Marshall Islands without evidencing substance. Full substance is required if the entity is tax resident (managed and controlled) in the Marshall Islands.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly filing false declarations with the Marshall Islands Registrar or misrepresenting the entity's tax residence to foreign tax authorities to evade taxes in another jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Marshall Islands Criminal Code, willful tax evasion and fraud carry fines up to USD 50,000 and/or imprisonment up to 5 years. The corporate charter may also be revoked by the Registrar.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, officers, or agents who knowingly participate in such misrepresentation are personally liable for the tax loss and may face civil restitution, travel bans, disqualification orders, and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a shell with no real economic presence while undertaking a relevant activity under the ESR, such as holding intellectual property from the video app without any management, staff, or assets in the Marshall Islands.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR non-compliance penalties: initial fine up to USD 10,000 and continuing penalty up to USD 20,000 per year; possible strike-off of the company and referral to OECD for harmful tax practices.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly manage an entity without economic substance are jointly and severally liable for penalties, plus civil restitution and travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing payments through Apple IAP or Paymentwall without implementing adequate anti-money laundering controls, or using the video-match app to launder illicit proceeds or fund terrorism through in-app virtual gifts or premium memberships.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Marshall Islands Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Act, penalties include fines up to USD 100,000 or twice the value of the transaction, whichever is higher, and imprisonment up to 10 years. Assets linked to prohibited activity are subject to confiscation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for failure to maintain an effective AML compliance programme; they may face criminal prosecution, travel bans, attachment of personal assets, and extradition to requesting states.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to Maintain Registered Agent and Annual Filings
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the Annual Business Report or failure to maintain a registered agent and registered office in the Marshall Islands for more than one year.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Registrar may administratively dissolve the BC after 90 days' notice; reinstatement requires payment of all outstanding annual fees, penalties (typically USD 100–USD 500), and a reinstatement fee.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Post-dissolution, directors may be personally liable for debts incurred in the company's name during the period of non-compliance; travel bans may be imposed to secure the payment of public liabilities.
